message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on engineered quartz slabs. The "CM1586QX" style with a polished white surface in large slab dimensions suggests an agglomerated quartz surface product. Such slabs are classified under 6810.99 (articles of artificial stone) or 6810.11 (building blocks)... Engineered quartz slabs have typically been ruled under 6810.99.0010 ("Other articles: Slabs of quartz surface products"). 6810.99.0010 reads "Other articles: Of quartz agglomerate" or similar; I recall that 6810.99.00 has 10-digit statistical suffixes, with 6810.99.0010 covering "Quartz surface products" and 6810.99.0080 covering other. The CBP laboratory analysis would have found the slab to be agglomerated quartz with resin, so the best answer is 6810.99.0010.

{"hts_code": "6810.99.0010", "reason": "The polished white slab is an engineered (agglomerated) quartz surface product, which is an article of artificial stone classified in heading 6810 as a quartz surface product slab."}
